quote: We applied SC-GPT, a fine-tuned language model conditioned on the dialog acts, to paraphrase the sentences as data augmentation.

To ensure the quality of our augmented test set, we conduct human annotation on 1,000 sampled utterances in each augmented test set of MultiWOZ. We ask annotators to check whether our augmented utterances are reasonable and our auto-detected value annotations are correct (two true-or-false questions).

guideline: Annotators check if augmented utterances are reasonable and auto-detected value annotations are correct, with method-specific criteria: for TP and SD, meaning and dialog acts unchanged; for WP, slot name same; for SR, similarity of pronunciation.

Annotators answer true/false questions checking (1) if the augmented utterance is reasonable, (2) if the dialog act annotation is correct; specific protocols: TP & SD – meaning unchanged; WP – slot name unchanged, slot value may change; SR – pronunciation similarity.

For TP and SD, annotators check whether the meaning of utterances and dialog acts are unchanged. For WP, changing slot values is allowed due to slot value replacement, but the slot name should be the same. For SR, annotators are asked to judge on the similarity of pronunciation rather than semantics.
